tha-ap24:5.1: nemī → pañca mikācehi (machasaṃ, PTS, sī.selu); tattha pañcamikā ceti (the)
tha-ap24:16.2: akaru’ttarakañcukaṃ → akaruṃ te ca kañcukaṃ (machasaṃ, sī.selu, the)
tha-ap24:17.4: uggato → “garuḷā”ti ādayo catasso gāthāyo, sī.selu, PTS potthakesu na vijjanti.
tha-ap24:25.4: tathā → kumbhaṇḍā guyahkā tathā (PTS); garuḷā kumbhayakkhakā (aṭṭhakathā, sīmu)
tha-ap24:27.2: te → yāva jaṅghā akaṃsu te (PTS, sī.selu); dhajaṃ chattamakaṃsu te (the)
tha-ap24:27.4: tadā → kumbhaṇḍādīnaṃ paṭipāṭiyā visadisatā ekaccesu dissati. PTS, sī.selu, the, potthakesu chayojanubbedhatā na vuttā. garuḷā ca vajjitā.
tha-ap24:35.4: kubbantanappakaṃ → kubbaṃ na tappare (machasaṃ, the); kubbanti tappare (PTS)
